pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A picture shows a father, but the label says 妈妈. Is the pair right or wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Right, 错
   B. Wrong, 错
   C. Wrong, 对
   D. Right, 对

2. What does 爱 (ài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Younger brother
   C. Mother
   D. Is, am, are

3. What does 哪儿 (nǎr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. House
   B. Window
   C. Where
   D. Toilet

4. How many rooms are named in 我家有客厅、卧室和厨房? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Five
   C. Three
   D. Two

5. Which word is pronounced jiàotáng? (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 明天
   C. 清真寺
   D. 教堂

6. Fill the blank: 星期一,星期二,星期____。 (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday) (1 mark)
   A. 五
   B. 三
   C. 四
   D. 天

7. Fill the blank: 我们切____。 (We cut the cake.) (1 mark)
   A. 礼物
   B. 快乐
   C. 朋友
   D. 蛋糕

8. What does 蛋糕 (dàngāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Plate
   C. Cake
   D. Friend

9. What does 芒果 (mángguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To like
   B. Biscuits
   C. Coffee
   D. Mango

10. Which word is pronounced wǎnfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 咖啡
   B. 晚饭
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 香蕉

11. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. I use my ears to hear.
   D. I use my eyes to see.

12. What is skimming? (1 mark)
   A. Reading quickly to get the general idea
   B. Copying a text
   C. Writing a text
   D. Looking for one word

13. What does 风来了 fēng lái le mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rain has come
   B. The snow is white
   C. The sun is big
   D. The wind has come

14. What does 不 (bù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Very
   C. Weather
   D. Not

15. Which sentence means "The bathroom is beside the garden."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 门在左边。
   C. 窗户在沙发上面。
   D. 浴室在花园旁边。

16. Read the pinyin: shāfā zài mén pángbiān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is beside the door.
   B. The television is on the table.
   C. The bed is in the bedroom.
   D. Where is the television?

17. How many strokes does 好 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 7

18. In 十, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. Both together
   B. Neither
   C. The horizontal 横
   D. The vertical 竖

19. What does 我家有五口人 mean? (1 mark)
   A. There are five people in my family
   B. I am five years old
   C. My house has five rooms
   D. I have five brothers

20. Which sentence means "This is my father."? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我哥哥。
   B. 我家有五口人。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 那是我弟弟。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有. (5 marks)

22. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father." (2 marks)

23. Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names. (2 marks)

24. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ. (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift." (3 marks)

26. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 香蕉 and 饼. (2 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a television in the living room." (3 marks)

28. Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。 (3 marks)

29. Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá. (3 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room." (2 marks)

31. Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Wrong, 错
   妈妈 is mother, not father.

2. A — Love
   爱 (ài) means love.

3. C — Where
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

4. C — Three
   The rooms are the living room, the bedroom and the kitchen.

5. D — 教堂
   教堂 is pronounced jiàotáng and means church.

6. B — 三
   The next day after Tuesday is Wednesday, 星期三.

7. D — 蛋糕
   蛋糕 is cake.

8. C — Cake
   蛋糕 (dàngāo) means cake.

9. D — Mango
   芒果 (mángguǒ) means mango.

10. B — 晚饭
   晚饭 is pronounced wǎnfàn and means dinner.

11. D — I use my eyes to see.
   wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. is 我用眼睛看。, which means "I use my eyes to see.".

12. A — Reading quickly to get the general idea
   Skimming gives you the main idea.

13. D — The wind has come
   风 is wind and 来了 is has come.

14. D — Not
   不 (bù) means not.

15. D — 浴室在花园旁边。
   浴室在花园旁边。 (yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.) means "The bathroom is beside the garden.".

16. A — The sofa is beside the door.
   shāfā zài mén pángbiān. is 沙发在门旁边。, which means "The sofa is beside the door.".

17. C — 6
   女 has 3 and 子 has 3.

18. C — The horizontal 横
   Horizontal comes before vertical when they cross.

19. A — There are five people in my family
   五口人 is five people.

20. C — 这是我爸爸。
   这是我爸爸。 (zhè shì wǒ bàba.) means "This is my father.".

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥。这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba. zhè shì wǒ māma. zhè shì wǒ gēge. zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, with pinyin and correct tones.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: I love you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 香蕉: xiāngjiāo, banana. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 客厅里有电视。 kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct position.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在客厅。 diànshì zài kètīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three steps.
